defs.def: the act of saving sb/sth from a dangerous or difficult situation; the fact of being saved 救援；营救；抢救；获救

ex.s: Seeing no hope of immediate rescue, Emily decided to spend the night in her car.
ex.t: 眼看没有立即获救的希望，Emily决定在车里过夜。

ex.s: But it can certainly keep me entertained while I wait for my wife to rescue me.
ex.t: 但它肯定能在我等妻子来解救我的时候让我保持愉悦。

ex.s: “It’s good to know there’s still someone out there who    56   enough to go to that kind of   57  ,”says Lisa of Ehlers’ rescue   58  .
ex.t: "知道还有人愿意付出那样的努力去救一只狗，真是太好了，"丽莎这样评价埃勒斯的救援行动。

ex.s: Trainees also get a good start on their Wilderness Survival badge as they learn about water- and land-survival through designed tasks and their search and rescue of “downed” pilot.
ex.t: 学员们在荒野求生徽章上也有一个良好的开端，他们通过设计好的任务和对"坠机"飞行员的搜救来学习水上和陆上生存知识。

ex.s: I work with Volunteers for Wildlife, a rescue and education organization at Bailey Arboretum in Locust Valley.
ex.t: 我在“野生动物志愿者”——一家位于洛克斯特谷贝利植物园的救援与教育组织——工作。

ex.s: I got a rescue call from a woman in Muttontown.
ex.t: 我接到芒顿镇一位女士的救援电话。

ex.s: What is unavoidable in the author’s rescue work according to paragraph 1?
ex.t: 根据第1段，作者的救援工作中什么是不可避免的？

ex.s: International rescue teams soon began to arrive in the country.
ex.t: 国际救援队很快开始抵达这个国家。

ex.s: Amongst all the international heavy rescue teams, the China International Search and Rescue Team (CISAR) was the first international heavy rescue team to arrive.
ex.t: 在所有国际重型救援队中，中国国际搜救队是第一支到达的国际重型救援队。

ex.s: More than three months later, Shackleton returned to Elephant Island to rescue the men that he had been forced to leave there.
ex.t: 三个多月后，沙克尔顿返回象岛，去营救那些他被迫留在那里的队员们。

ex.s: Saint-Exupéry nearly died, and wandered around for four days before being rescued.
ex.t: 圣埃克苏佩里差点丧命，他在获救前游荡了四天。

ex.s: After resuming communication with the base five days later, I was informed that it will be eight months before a rescue mission arrives from Earth.
ex.t: 五天后，在与基地恢复通信后，我被告知，救援任务从地球到达还需要八个月的时间。

defs.def: an occasion when sb/sth is saved from a dangerous or difficult situation 营救行动
